summary: Frontend-only test on the web preview (390x844, public URL, demo@heraapp.com logged in with password HeraDemo2024!). Both requested fixes PASS on web. (1) ONBOARDING MUSIC: a splash tap starts SoundHelix-Song-9.mp3 (HTMLMediaElement playing, volume fades to 0.3). It keeps playing through Welcome -> Referral -> Q1..Q3, on Next/Back, after 6s+ (no 3s auto-stop), on /login and when going back. It stops after logging in (paused on the tabs). The splash speaker button starts music without leaving the splash. On the question screens the speaker toggles volume 0 <-> 0.3 and the label switches between 'Mute music' and 'Unmute music' (icon volume-medium <-> volume-mute). No console errors. (2) OFFLINE GUARD (context.set_offline): navigator.onLine is false and the 'Internet not available' toast shows. A themed alert 'No Internet Connection / An internet connection is required to complete this action. Please reconnect and try again.' blocks all of these, and no data changes: Journal Save Entry (modal stays open, content kept, still 2 entries), Journal trash (alert shows instead of the delete confirm), Vision '+' (modal does not open), Vision detail trash -> Remove (blocked, still 4 visions), Chat send button and suggestion chip (no bubble added, input kept), Home manifest submit (blocked on chat), Profile Reset Journey, Upload Photo and the avatar camera badge (no file chooser), Delete Account -> type DELETE -> Delete Forever (blocked, modal stays), Visualization Begin Journey (stays on setup). After set_offline(False) the toast disappears and actions work again: a TEST_ journal entry was saved and then deleted, the Vision New Vision modal opens, chat sent a message and got an AI reply, and Visualization started a session. Edge cases and gaps found are listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: If the first load or play fails (network error, a blocked request, or autoplay NotAllowedError), soundRef.current still holds a broken player. Later speaker taps only change the volume, so music never recovers, while the icon shows 'volume-medium' (playing). Reproduced by aborting *.mp3 on the splash tap and then restoring the network: audio.error=4, currentTime stays 0, and speaker taps only flip the volume. Fix: in toggleMute, if the player is not playing or has errored, call play() (or unload and recreate the player) instead of toggling the volume. Reference: app/onboarding.tsx:689-738, src/utils/av-shim.ts:29-35

Offline submit clears the home input and navigates to chat, where the send is blocked, but the chat input is empty, so the typed text is lost. Guard handleSubmit with requireOnline() before router.push, or prefill the chat input. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:292-299

integration_issues.issue: These network actions are not guarded: Chat 'Clear Conversation' (handleClearChat -> clearChat -> clearRemoteChat; it clears locally and the remote call fails silently, chat.tsx:128-142); Profile Cloud Sync refresh (syncNow; offline it silently shows 'Just now', profile.tsx:726, HeraContext.tsx:329-350, because lastSyncedAt is set even when result.errors is not empty); profile edit save via updateUser -> pushUserData; favorite affirmation toggles (index.tsx:217, discover.tsx:100); Log Out. These edits are saved locally and then fail to sync silently.

Inconsistent with Journal: the 'Remove Vision' confirm is shown first and the offline alert only appears after tapping Remove. Journal blocks before the confirm. Consider calling requireOnline() in the detail handleDelete before showAlert. Reference: app/(tabs)/vision.tsx:597-602

issues: The 'Internet not available' toast covers the screen title/header (e.g. 'Journal', 'Vision Board', chat header name)
The toast is hidden behind full-screen modals (vision detail, journal New Entry), so offline status is not visible there until an action is attempted
Onboarding music keeps playing on /login (onboarding stays mounted) and there is no mute control on that screen

react_native_issues.issue: Metro warns about a cycle: template/index.ts -> template/core/emergent-client.ts -> src/api.ts -> src/utils/network.ts -> template/index.ts. It works today because useAlert is only used inside the hook, but it is fragile. Move useRequireOnline into a separate file (e.g. src/hooks/useRequireOnline.ts) so api.ts -> network.ts does not import @/template. Reference: src/utils/network.ts:9

Native: online = !(isConnected===false || isInternetReachable===false). On Android/iOS, isInternetReachable can be false for a moment, or when the reachability probe host is blocked, which would block every action while the device is actually online. Consider debouncing or relying on isConnected and only treating reachability as false after it has been settled for a short time. Could not be verified on web. Reference: src/utils/network.ts:24-26

action_items: MEDIUM: Make the onboarding speaker recover a failed or blocked player. When the player is not playing or has an error, call play() or recreate it (onboarding.tsx toggleMute/startAudio)
Add requireOnline() to Chat Clear Conversation, Profile Cloud Sync refresh, profile edit save, favorite toggles and (optionally) Log Out
Fix syncNow so it does not set lastSyncedAt/'Just now' when result.errors is not empty
Guard Home manifest submit before navigating (or prefill the chat input) so the typed text is not lost offline
Vision detail delete: check requireOnline() before showing the 'Remove Vision' confirm, as Journal does
Break the require cycle by moving useRequireOnline out of src/utils/network.ts
Optional: stop or mute onboarding music on /login, or offer a mute control there
critical_code_review_comments: network.ts: the module-level `online` flag starts as true on native until the first NetInfo event. That is acceptable, but NetInfo.fetch() is never called at startup
profile.tsx handleSendDeletionOTP: when there is no session it sets deleteStep='success' (local delete + logout) without calling the backend. This existed before this change, but it is risky
onboarding.tsx (1100+ lines) and profile.tsx (1133 lines) exceed the 700-line guideline

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (onboarding music 7/7 checks, offline guard 13/13 blocked actions, online recovery 4/4); 1 medium edge case + coverage gaps reported

seed_data_creation: One journal entry 'TEST_it32 Entry' was created online and then deleted through the UI. One chat message 'TEST_it32 say hi in five words' (and the AI reply) exists only in a throwaway browser context's localStorage; it was not found in local MongoDB. No demo/seed data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts a fresh context and loads page_url BEFORE the script runs, so add_init_script hooks need an explicit page.goto(). Hook HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play to capture expo-audio's element and check .paused/.volume/.currentTime. Demo login: seed localStorage hera_onboarded='"true"', go to /login, fill input[placeholder='you@example.com'], click 'Sign In', fill input[placeholder='Enter password'] with HeraDemo2024!, click 'Sign In & Continue'. Offline: page.context.set_offline(True). Do NOT page.goto while offline; use tab aria-labels ('vision', 'profile', ...). Journal + button is at (345,33) and the first card trash at (341,237). Chat send button selector: 'textarea + div'. Vision detail trash is at (346,28). The offline alert OK button is get_by_text('OK', exact=True).
rca_of_issue: Onboarding speaker edge case: toggleMute only calls startAudio when soundRef.current is null. Sound.createAsync (av-shim) always returns a player even when loading or playing fails, so after a failed first attempt soundRef is not null and every later tap only sets the volume. To reproduce: page.route('**/*.mp3', abort) -> tap splash -> unroute -> tap speaker on Q1 -> audio.error=4, currentTime=0.
